questions.text: What is the sum of the first 20 terms of the arithmetic progression $3, 7, 11, 15, \dots$?
questions.explanation: Here first term $a_1 = 3$, common difference $d = 4$, and $n = 20$. Using the AP sum formula: $$S_n = \frac{n}{2} [2a_1 + (n - 1)d]$$ $$S_{20} = \frac{20}{2} [2(3) + (19)(4)] = 10 [6 + 76] = 10(82) = 820$$

questions.text: A polynomial equation of degree $n$ with complex coefficients has exactly $n$ complex roots (counting multiplicities). This is known as which theorem?
questions.explanation: The Fundamental Theorem of Algebra states that every non-constant single-variable polynomial with complex coefficients has at least one complex root, which implies an $n$-th degree polynomial has exactly $n$ roots counting multiplicity.
